test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding Chandrayaan-1 mission?

I. It was the first lunar mission of India.

II. It confirmed the presence of water on the Moon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement I:** Chandrayaan-1 was the **first lunar mission of India**. It was launched on **22 October 2008** by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**. This mission marked India’s entry into the elite group of nations capable of lunar exploration. Hence, statement I is correct.</em&
